provenance.scope: the walk's end: the choice beside the look up and the plate it opens, words by key
provenance.learn_word: ending.learn.word names the choice beside the look up by the place its plate leads to, EN and DE.
provenance.lobby_word: ending.lobby.word stands over the look up on every form and says what the press does: the walk ends and the visitor leaves the wing. The key keeps its older name.
provenance.destination: The choice opens Leonardo's mode choice in the library (`/app?figure=leonardo-da-vinci&lang=<lang>`), not a conversation: no question rides the address.
provenance.words: ending.plate.title, ending.plate.line and ending.plate.go were written for the new destination (four candidate sets) and read blind once; the reader's pick combines three of the written strings unchanged. Every other sentence of the plate (the library line, the Echo's disclosure, the terms) is the frame's own and stays as it is.

line.en: You walked where he lived and saw what he made. Now you can read on and ask.
line.de: Du warst, wo er lebte, und hast gesehen, was er schuf. Jetzt kannst du weiterlesen und fragen.
